mentions.name: Codako
mentions.description: Codako is a web-based programming-by-demonstration environment for building games and simulations, a rebuild of the classic Cocoa / Stagecast Creator. It uses a simulation environment with a low floor and high ceiling for creativity to introduce programming fundamentals, and is being user-tested via game-building jams in local libraries.
mentions.audience: Beginners learning programming fundamentals, user-tested through game-building jams in local libraries
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently partnered with Dave Smith (one of the original authors + members of Apple's Advanced Research group in the 90s, and low-key the inventor of the icon) and we're rebuilding it for the web:

https://www.codako.org/

I'm user testing it this fall with game-building jams in local libraries.
mentions.author: bengotow
